string-array.name: jokes_gentle
string-array.item: Hey {name}, that app will still be there in an hour. Your exam won\'t wait as patiently.
Nice try, {name}. Your future self is quietly cheering for you right now.
One more chapter first, {name}. Then you can scroll guilt-free.
{name}, you opened that out of habit, not need. Let\'s break the habit together.
Deep breath, {name}. The urge passes in about 90 seconds. Study through it.
You\'ve got this, {name}. Even five focused minutes count.
Little steps, {name}. Back to the book and the rest takes care of itself.
The phone can wait, {name}. Your goals can\'t be rescheduled.

string-array.name: jokes_funny
string-array.item: Plot twist, {name}: the notification was not important. It never is.
Breaking news: local student tries to open a blocked app. Sources say it did not go well.
{name}, your thumb has a mind of its own. Time to train it like a puppy.
Congratulations {name}, you unlocked the Procrastination achievement. Reward: a textbook.
I\'m not saying you\'re addicted, {name}, but your thumb just opened that app on autopilot.
Error 404: self-control not found. Please refresh your motivation.
Wow {name}, the syllabus called. It says it misses you.
Your phone says \'Open me!\' and your syllabus says \'Excuse me?!\' Guess who\'s winning, {name}.

string-array.name: jokes_savage
string-array.item: {name}, you can\'t even stay focused for one study session. Wow, how impressive.
Opening that app again, {name}? Your marks are not going to scroll themselves up.
Bold of you to think you\'d pass by scrolling, {name}.
{name}, even your phone is tired of watching you not study.
Another day, another attempt to dodge the syllabus, {name}. Same result: blocked.
You said \'just five minutes\', {name}. That was three hours ago. Every time.
A goldfish can focus longer than you right now, {name}. Prove it wrong.
If procrastination were a subject, you\'d be topping it, {name}.

string-array.name: jokes_reels
string-array.item: Reels will not get you through the exam, {name}. Nobody has ever been tested on them.
That \'one quick reel\' is a lie we all tell ourselves, {name}. It\'s never just one.
The reel algorithm knows you better than your syllabus does. Let\'s fix that.
Reels are infinite, {name}. Your exam date is not.

string-array.name: jokes_youtube
string-array.item: YouTube is great for studying until you\'re 40 minutes into a video about how bridges are built, {name}.
Shorts are called short because they steal your time in short bursts, {name}.
Your watch history is longer than your revision list, {name}.
Recommended for you: the chapter you\'ve been avoiding.

string-array.name: jokes_games
string-array.item: The game will still have its next level tomorrow, {name}. Your exam won\'t wait.
Your rank in the game is great. Now rank up in your studies, {name}.
Respawn is for games, {name}. Exams give you one attempt.
\'Ten more minutes of the game,\' you said. The sun is already up.

string-array.name: jokes_chats
string-array.item: The group chat has 200 new messages and none of them are important, {name}.
\'Seen\' can wait, {name}. Your chapter can\'t.
Whatever they sent is not going anywhere. Reply after the session.
Your friends will survive if you reply in an hour, {name}.

string-array.name: jokes_goal_school
string-array.item: Boards don\'t care how many reels you watched, {name}.
Your teachers would love to see this level of dedication to the syllabus, {name}.
Every page you read now is one less panic later, {name}.

string-array.name: jokes_goal_comp
string-array.item: Somewhere, someone preparing for the same exam just closed this app, {name}. Your move.
Rank lists are made of daily hours, {name}, not good intentions.
The competition is not scrolling right now, {name}.

string-array.name: jokes_goal_college
string-array.item: Assignments don\'t do themselves, {name}. I\'ve waited. Trust me.
Semester exams are coming, {name}. They always are.
Future you wants an internship. Present you wants a reel. Choose wisely, {name}.

string-array.name: jokes_goal_skill
string-array.item: Skills compound, {name}. So does the time you waste.
You said you\'d learn this skill this year. Make today count, {name}.
A tutorial a day beats a scroll a day, {name}.

string-array.name: jokes_night
string-array.item: It\'s late, {name}. Sleep is the best study hack and this app is not part of it.
Nothing good happens on a phone after midnight, {name}. Go to sleep.
Your brain files what you learned while you sleep, {name}. Give it something worth filing.

string-array.name: jokes_phone
string-array.item: You spend {hours} on your phone each day, {name}. Imagine what that would do for your marks.
{hours} a day on the phone, {name}. Let\'s borrow just a little of it for studying.
Fun fact: {hours} a day adds up to weeks of your year, {name}. Let\'s invest some in yourself.
